ruled_out_vectors.vector: H1: Malicious pool type returns fake amounts to steal from LPs
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Pool type address requires 6 leading zero bytes (~2^48 mining cost). Core validates via reserve decrements (_safeDecrementUint128 reverts on underflow), balance checks (AMMModule.sol:2208), and protocol fee validation. A malicious pool type can only harm its own LPs who chose that pool type.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H2: Malicious transfer handler skips actual transfer so core believes funds arrived
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Balance check at AMMModule.sol:2208 ensures balanceInBefore + amountIn == balanceInAfter. Handler MUST actually transfer tokens. Both CLOB and Permit handlers validate msg.sender == AMM.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H3: Malicious hook manipulates price limits to extract from swappers
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: All hook entry points (beforeSwap, afterSwap, validateAddLiquidity, validatePoolCreation) check _requireCallerIsAMM() at AMMStandardHook.sol:940-943. External callers cannot invoke hooks directly.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H4: Pool type address collision (6 leading zero bytes)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Address space with 6 leading zero bytes = 2^112 possible addresses. Collision is astronomically unlikely. CREATE2 mining to match an existing pool type address is infeasible (2^48 work per address).
SecureProxy is a simple EIP-1967 proxy, not UUPS or beacon. Upgrade requires SECURE_PROXY_ADMIN_ROLE + TIER_ADMIN pause state. No initializer race condition.
Not a diamond proxy with facets. Single implementation address with EIP-1967 proxy. No selector routing.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H7: CREATE2 destroy and redeploy at same address
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Solidity 0.8.24 targets Cancun EVM where selfdestruct is deprecated/noop. No CREATE2 redeploy attack possible.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H8: Malicious facet writes to another facet's storage slot
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Single implementation proxy, not diamond with multiple facets. No cross-facet storage collision possible.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H9: Facet management bypass for code injection
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Not applicable - single implementation proxy with admin-only upgrade path. No facet management system.
_requireCallerIsAMM() on all hook entry points (beforeSwap L110, afterSwap L159, validateAddLiquidity L253, validatePoolCreation L312). Cannot invoke hooks without going through AMM.
Single implementation EIP-1967 proxy. No diamond facets, no multi-facet storage layout, no collision surface.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Mandatory Probe: Permit mutation (feeOnTop field manipulation)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: feeOnTop is NOT signed in SWAP_TYPEHASH but limitAmount IS signed and caps total exposure. Attacker cannot extract more than signer authorized via limitAmount.

Known Low (HOOK-001/CP-001). Transient storage slot overwrite is by-design: AMM calls beforeSwap per-token, second intentionally overwrites first. No extraction path beyond known informational finding.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Mandatory Probe: Dust-loop extraction via repeated tiny swaps
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Fee rounding in FeeHelper.sol: input fees use mulDiv (rounds down, against attacker), output fees use mulDivRoundingUp (rounds up, against attacker). Pool type swap calculations also round against swapper. No profitable dust-loop path.
_setReentrancyFlags(NO_FLAGS) clears custom flags but preserves ENTERED bit. Handler callback executed post-finalization cannot reenter swap/liquidity functions.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: CreatorHookSettingsRegistry settings change to trap LPs
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: setTokenSettings requires LibOwnership.requireCallerIsTokenOrContractOwnerOrAdmin(token). Only token owner/admin can change settings. This is self-inflicted config (FP pattern #4). Whitelist creation is open but only creates empty lists owned by caller.

theft_theses.thesis: Malicious pool type returns inflated swap amounts to drain LP reserves
theft_theses.victim: LPs who deposited into pool with malicious pool type

theft_theses.thesis: Malicious transfer handler skips token transfer while core credits the swap
theft_theses.victim: Pool LPs (reserves decremented without corresponding token inflow)

theft_theses.thesis: Direct hook invocation to manipulate pricing bounds and extract from swappers
